message.content: The Communications Solutions Group reported revenue of $1,345 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, driven by 56 percent growth in commercial communications and 14 percent growth in aerospace, defense, and government [D1]. The Electronic Industrial Solutions Group reported revenue of $501 million for the quarter, reflecting growth across the semiconductor, general electronics, automotive, and energy markets [D1]. Total segment operating income grew to $613 million from $338 million a year earlier as both groups expanded their contributions to overall profitability [D1]. The company's full-year outlook was improved with fourth quarter revenue guidance ranging between $1.930 billion and $1.950 billion [D1].
